EmailTemplate.description: Contract Renewal Reminder email template used by ContractRenewalBatch Apex job. This template is triggered 60 days and 30 days before Contract End Date for MSA contracts. The template contains a placeholder (<!--SFX_TABLE_PLACEHOLDER-->) that is dynamically replaced by Apex with a table of linked SFX Accounts. Recipients include MSA Local NAM, their Manager, and Regional Manager with exclusion logic for Rubal Jain (70002).
EmailTemplate.name: Contract Renewal Template
EmailTemplate.subject: Renewal Reminder - Contract Expiring | msaAccountName
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear localNamName,
This is a reminder that the below contract is scheduled to end on {!Contract__c.Contract_End_Date__c}.
Contract Details
Contract Name: {!Contract__c.Name} Contract End Date: {!Contract__c.Contract_End_Date__c} MSA Code: msaAccountName
Account (MSA) msaAccountName
Linked SFX Accounts SFXCodeTable
Kindly review the contract and initiate the renewal process to ensure business continuity across the MSA and all associated SFX accounts.
Please take the necessary action before the end date to avoid service or revenue disruption.
Regards, Team Safexpress
